_comment: Character reference-sheet T2I reference graph (FLUX.1-dev) in ComfyUI API format. Despite the legacy 'qwen' filename, this uses FLUX.1-dev because faces/portraits come out cleaner. The pipeline appends 'front/side/emotion view, character reference sheet, plain background, full body' to {{POS_PROMPT}} and calls it 3x. Placeholders: {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{SEED}} {{WIDTH}} {{HEIGHT}}. IMPORTANT: FLUX.1-dev is a distilled guidance model run at KSampler cfg=1.0, so the negative prompt is INERT (FLUX ignores negatives) — {{NEG_PROMPT}} is still wired into KSampler.negative to preserve the placeholder contract, but it has no effect. If you need real negative prompts, switch this file to an SDXL graph (see keyframe_flux_api.json for the SDXL pattern). REQUIRED MODELS: diffusion_models/flux1-dev.safetensors ; text_encoders/t5xxl_fp16.safetensors + clip_l.safetensors ; vae/ae.safetensors. All nodes are ComfyUI core (no custom nodes).
